hack.root_cause: Infinite mint via incomplete collateral validation — fake account chain bypasses all verification
hack.description: An attacker minted 2 billion $CASH by exploiting a gap in Cashio's collateral validation that never checked the `.mint` field — creating a chain of fake Solana accounts that each vouched for the others.
